🖨 Bulk pick sheet (Admin / Supervisor) - tap to open ▼

For a bulk order: paste or upload a list, one product per line — SKU or ASIN, quantity (e.g. AZPER200565FRA_NM_01-S1_NB, 12). The app takes each product from the bin with the least stock first, reserves those units so no other order gets them, and prints a sheet with one QR per bin. Anything not in stock is listed as not available. Upload the Excel template (⬇ Download template) or a CSV file.

❓ Which button do I press?
  • New Stock - new goods arrived. Returns - a customer sent something back.
  • Found - stock turned up that was not counted. Remove/Lost - lost, broken or stolen.
  • QC Hold - set aside for a quality check. QC Release - passed the check, put back on sale.
  • Set True Count - you counted a bin; type what is really there. Dispatch Out - an order leaves without a pick slip. Transfer - move stock from one bin to another.
  • Changing the button clears the SKU, bin, quantity and note you typed.

💾 Bulk Upload (CSV)

For many rows at once. Download the template, fill it in Excel, then upload it here. The template is a real Excel file — drop-down on the Action column, filters, an Instructions sheet and worked sample rows, so there is no guessing what to type. Save it as CSV before uploading. Action can be: INBOUND, RETURN_IN, FOUND, LOST, REJECTED, QC_HOLD, QC_RELEASE, TRANSFER (needs both Bin and ToBin), or DISPATCH (stock leaving for an order — put the order number in the ToBin column).
In plain words: INBOUND = new stock in. RETURN_IN = customer return. FOUND = extra stock found. LOST = lost or stolen. REJECTED = failed the quality check and taken out. QC_HOLD = set aside for a check. QC_RELEASE = put back after a check. TRANSFER = move between bins. DISPATCH = leaves for an order. Rows marked OK are saved; if some fail, fix only those rows and upload them again.

    🔧 Fix-It Centre ▼

    The system checks every active listing for real faults every 30 minutes. Open an issue to fix it in the listing sheet. Ignore needs a reason, and ignored issues stay visible under the Ignored filter with who ignored them and why. Snooze hides an issue for 7 or 30 days, then it returns if the fault is still there.

    🧾 Change GST in bulk ▼

    Changes the GST % on many listings at once. Cost after tax is recalculated automatically as cost before tax × (1 + GST). You always see a preview first; nothing is saved until you press Apply and confirm with your PIN. There is no automatic undo. To go back, run this again with the old GST % as the new value for the same SKUs. Every bulk change is recorded in the change log.

    🗄 Bins ▼

    Every bin in the warehouse and what it holds. A bin is created automatically the first time stock is put into it, so a typing mistake makes a stray bin (that is how "22" appeared on 25-Sep). Delete removes an empty bin for good; Off hides it from the lists but keeps it; Not for picking keeps the stock out of order picking (e.g. QC-HOLD). A bin that still holds stock cannot be deleted — transfer or count it out first.

    Start here. This guide explains how to use ArtzFolio OMS on your phone: pick orders, record stock, find stock and fix mistakes. New? Read “Daily Workflow” first. Steps marked (laptop) are done on the office computer, not on the phone. Guide updated for app v168, 24 Oct 2026.

    📋 Daily Workflow

    1. Amazon orders (laptop): on the laptop run the print step (2_MERGE_AND_STAMP) and print the QR file. Printing an invoice holds its stock until the slip is scanned.
    2. Pick orders: tap the camera and scan the pick QR on the slip. Go to the bin, scan the product, the slip finishes with a green Picked ✓.
    3. Other sales (Shopify, Flipkart, Myntra, direct, referral): Move stock → Send out. Channel is compulsory; the order reference is compulsory for Amazon channels. One sale is booked in one place only.
    4. Stock coming in, returns, found, lost, QC hold / release, transfers, counts: Move stock. A bin is needed on every movement, including Correct the count.
    5. Raw materials (Raw Materials): items, vendors, receiving, bills and raw-material stock. Making (Make Orders): production jobs and what they use. Customers (Customers): customer list, orders, warranty and quotes. Reports (Dashboard): sales, stock, forecast and production figures. Each opens with a short line saying what it is for. Admin and Supervisor see them; others only when the Admin switches them on. The lower menu shows Today, Stock, Orders, Labels and More (you only see the groups your role may open).
    6. Finding stock: Find stock. Type a SKU, ASIN, name or size (4x6, 4 by 6). Suggestions appear as you type; tap a result for the full SKU page.
    7. Stock history: full stock history with filters. A wrong entry is corrected with Void (Supervisor / Admin PIN). Void before the Excel Daily Inventory Sync push.
    8. Dashboard: Overview, Sales, Inventory, Forecast, Production (needs the Analytics permission). Tap any row to open its SKU page.
    9. Product Listings (Admin / Supervisor): find a listing, open it, edit fields, switch ON / OFF, or Quick Add. Percentages are typed as %, for example 18 for 18%. If you leave the app, the open sheet is kept for 3 minutes.
    10. Every title, SKU, ASIN, order, bin and entry number has a small 📋 button: tap it to copy.

    📷 Camera — How to Open & Scan

    1. Tap the blue camera button inside the app (in the scan bar at the top)
    2. Tap Allow when Chrome asks for camera permission
    3. The camera overlay will open — point it at a barcode or QR code
    4. Supported formats: QR Code, Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF, DataMatrix, PDF417, Aztec
    5. Tap the floating ✕ button (top of the camera view) to close the scanner anytime; the phone's Back button now also safely closes the scanner instead of exiting the app
    6. If the camera button shows an error banner: use a Bluetooth scanner or type the code manually and press Enter

    📱 Opening the App on a Phone

    1. Open the ArtzFolio OMS link your Admin gave you (it looks like oms.artzfolio.com) in Chrome and sign in with your code and PIN.
    2. Chrome menu → Add to Home screen, so it opens like an app.
    3. Tap Allow when Chrome asks for the camera.
    4. If the small badge at the top corner does not show the newest version, close the app completely and open it again, or pull down to refresh.
    5. Camera still blocked: Chrome menu → Settings → Site settings → Camera → Allow for this site.

    📚 Glossary

    Reserved / Held stock — Units kept aside for an order because its pick slip was printed. No other order can take them until the slip is picked or released
    QC (quality check) — Hold for quality check sets stock aside while it is checked; Release from quality check puts it back on sale after it passes
    A / B / C tier — How fast a product sells: A sells fastest, C sells slowest or not at all yet
    Reorder point — The stock level at which it is time to buy or make more
    Make to order — A product with no stock when the slip was printed; it is made after the order comes in. The slip says DO NOT PICK
    Cycle count — A short daily list of products to recount on the shelf so mistakes are caught early
    Buying pattern — In CUST: how often and how recently a customer buys (for example Champions, At risk)
    PIN — Your own secret number. It proves it is you before costs, customer details or stock changes are shown or saved. Ask the Admin if you forget it
    AF2 — ArtzFolio pick-list QR format. All pick-list QR codes start with AF2|
    BIN — Physical shelf location. BIN QR stickers are on the shelf/rack. Bin QR data starts with BIN|
    ASIN — Amazon product ID. Its Code 128 barcode on the product label is accepted at step 3 instead of the SKU barcode
    Set Size — Pieces inside one sellable unit (e.g. Set of 10 = 10 pieces packed together)

    🔄 ACTIONS / STOCK / Bulk Upload — Bin-Level Stock

    • Move stock — records one stock movement at a time (New Stock In / Returns In / Found / Remove-Lost / Hold for quality check / Release from quality check / Correct the count / Transfer). A Bin is required on every movement, including Correct the count — the app auto-fills the SKU's usual bin, but you can always overwrite it (e.g. new stock landing in RECEIVING instead of the SKU's normal shelf).
    • Correct the count — a pill on the Move stock, for a physical stock count only (not daily use). This counts ONE BIN at a time. Type the bin you physically counted and the number you found in that bin; the app compares it against what that same bin currently shows and saves only the difference. Any other bin holding the same SKU is listed in the confirmation box and is never changed. A note is recommended but not required. Bin is required here too, like every other action.
      Why one bin at a time: an older version compared your one-bin count against the SKU's total across every bin, so counting a SKU that lived in two bins silently pushed one bin negative — and the next action on that bin then failed with a confusing error. If a SKU sits in several bins, count each bin separately.
    • 💾 Bulk DISPATCH — The Bulk Upload (CSV) list now also accepts DISPATCH, for booking out many orders at once. Put the order number in the ToBin column. This is the same action, same wording and same column as the Excel sheet's DISPATCH, so one filled-in sheet works in either place.
    • 📤 Send out — A button on the Move stock. Use it whenever stock physically leaves for a customer order. Scan the SKU, confirm the bin it came from, enter how many, and add the order number and channel.
      Why this matters: low-stock alerts, the fast / slow seller tiers (A / B / C) and the forecast are all worked out from what leaves the warehouse. Book every dispatch here, or finish the pick on the Pick orders, so those figures stay right.
    • 🗃 Product Listings (Admin / Supervisor) — find any listing, Open it to see and edit every field from Excel tab 6, switch it ON or OFF for stock, or use Quick Add Listing for a product that is not in the system yet (title, SKU, ASIN, product type; bin and opening stock optional). Every change is confirmed with your own PIN and recorded in the Audit Log. The Bins section lists every bin and lets you delete an empty one.
      What happens if you just scan an unknown code instead: nothing is ever placed in a random bin. On New Stock or Returns an amber “Register New SKU” panel opens so you can add it and carry straight on. On Remove/Lost, Hold for quality check, Release from quality check or Correct the count the app refuses outright — counting or removing something that was never received is a mistake, not a new product.
    • Release from quality check — a pill on the Move stock, previously only reachable via Bulk Upload (CSV). Releases stock that was QC-Held back into sellable count, using the same SKU/Bin/Qty/Note form as the rest of this tab.
    • Transfer — a button on the Move stock. Moves existing stock from one bin to another — the SKU's total is unchanged. Enter the bin it's moving FROM (the usual Bin field), the bin it's moving INTO, and the quantity. Writes as two linked rows (stock out of the old bin, into the new one) — the same way a bulk-upload TRANSFER row already worked, just as a single-item action here. To move an entire scanned session's contents to a different bin in one go, use the Admin Panel's Scan Sessions page instead.
    • Bulk Upload (CSV) — on the Move stock: download the template, fill it, upload. There are exactly 8 allowed Action values, and the Excel template now blocks anything else:
      • INBOUND — New stock arriving into the warehouse for the first time — a fresh purchase or production batch being put away. (adds to stock; needs SKU, Bin, Qty)
      • RETURN_IN — A customer return physically received back into the warehouse. (adds to stock; needs SKU, Bin, Qty)
      • FOUND — Untracked stock discovered during a physical count — genuinely present on the shelf but missing from the system. (adds to stock; needs SKU, Bin, Qty)
      • LOST — Stock leaving the system without a sale: missing, shrinkage, theft, damage, expiry or any deliberate write-off. Put the actual reason in the Note column — that is what separates a breakage from a theft in the permanent record. (reduces stock; needs SKU, Bin, Qty, Note)
      • REJECTED — Stock that failed a quality check and is being taken out of sellable stock permanently. (reduces stock; needs SKU, Bin, Qty, Note)
      • QC_HOLD — Quarantine: takes stock out of the sellable count while it waits for a quality decision. The goods are still physically there — they just must not be sold yet. Release them later with QC_RELEASE. (reduces stock; needs SKU, Bin, Qty)
      • QC_RELEASE — The opposite of QC_HOLD — passes quarantined stock back into the sellable count after it clears its quality check. (adds to stock; needs SKU, Bin, Qty)
      • TRANSFER — Moves stock from one shelf location to another. Total stock does not change — only where it sits. Bin is where it is moving FROM, ToBin is where it is moving TO. (moves between bins, total unchanged; needs SKU, Bin, ToBin, Qty)
      TRANSFER is the only Action that uses ToBin, and one TRANSFER row deliberately writes two ledger entries (out of one bin, into the other) so the move is traceable at both ends. Every row needs a Bin and a positive Qty — never type a negative quantity, the Action itself decides the direction. Same per-row OK/FAILED result as before.
    • Bin-mismatch note — if the bin you use is different from that SKU's usual bin, the result still says OK (this is never blocked) but adds a short note so you can catch a typo, e.g. "OK (note: this SKU's usual bin is A12, this entry used B04)".
    • Find stock — live, read-only view of current quantities. Search by SKU, ASIN, or Bin to find where something is right now.
    • Actions / STOCK / Bulk Upload all write to the SAME live database as this Excel file and the Admin Panel — there is no separate copy anywhere, and every write is tagged with which tool made it (visible to an admin as "entry_source").

    🔧 Troubleshooting

    • Camera button does nothing / black overlay — Tap the blue button inside the app (not the Chrome address bar icon). On first use, wait 2–3 s for permission prompt
    • QR not scanning — Hold phone 15–25 cm from QR code, good light, keep still; the orange scanning line shows it is active
    • Product mismatch — Try scanning the ASIN barcode instead of SKU label (or vice versa)
    • Wrong bin scanned — Tap ← Back, go to the correct bin and scan again
    • The pick will not finish — Check every line shows its full quantity scanned. The slip finishes with a green Picked ✓ only when all lines are done.
    • QR missing in Excel pick list — Re-run Step3_GenerateBarcodes in Excel

    🔒 Held stock
    ❓ What is this screen?
    • Printing reserves stock. When pick slips are printed, their units are held for those orders, so no other order can take them.
    • Picking removes it. Scanning the slip, the bin and the product takes the units out of stock - the hold ends there.
    • Release only if an order was cancelled or will not be packed. Releasing puts the units back as free stock, and that slip will no longer work.
    • Finished batches close by themselves once nothing in them is held any more.
    📋 Reserved stock
    ❓ What is reserved stock? When should I release it?
    • Reserved means these units are kept aside for one order, because a pick slip was printed (Amazon bill stamping) or a bulk / Excel pick sheet was made. No other order can take them.
    • Picking the slip (slip, bin, product) takes the units out and ends the reservation by itself.
    • Release a line only when it will not be picked: the order was cancelled, or the team already packed that order from other stock.
    • Order already dispatched another way the same order and product already left stock by another route (phone dispatch, bulk or Excel), or its Amazon order line is marked picked. Usually safe to release — check first.
    • Some units of this order already went out another way part of the order went out by another route, but not all the reserved units. Check before releasing.
    • Old – check held more than 2 days. Find out if the order is still coming.
    • All dates and times on this screen are India time (IST).
    • Releasing only frees the stock in this app. It does not change or cancel anything on Amazon. The printed slip for that line stops working.
